title: OVENTE Premium Stainless Steel Colander Set of 3 with Comfortable Large Handles, 1.5, 3, 5 Quarts Essential Kitchen Strainer for Draining Spaghetti Pasta, Rinsing Vegetables or Fruits, Silver C46263S
description:
About this item
SET OF 3 VERSATILE COLANDERS – Upgrade your kitchen with this 3-piece stainless steel colander set, designed for maximum convenience and versatility. With 1.5, 3 and 5-quart capacities, you can choose the perfect size for any task from rinsing fruits and vegetables, draining pasta, straining rice or washing seafood.
DURABLE STAINLESS STEEL – Crafted from high-quality, food-grade stainless steel for long-lasting performance, these colanders are rust-resistant, shatterproof and dent-resistant, making them more durable than other colanders. These colanders are also compatible with our Mixing Bowl Set BM46333S, making them a perfect addition to your kitchen for seamless food prep.
SPACE-SAVING DESIGN – These stackable colanders fit beautifully inside each other, allowing for efficient storage in your cabinets or on your countertop, keeping your kitchen tidy and organized. Plus, the comfortable large handles provide a secure grip, making them even easier to use for everyday kitchen tasks.
DISHWASHER SAFE – Cleaning has never been easier .Simply load these colanders into the dishwasher for hassle-free cleaning, or quickly hand wash by rinsing with warm, soapy water. To maintain their durability and shine, it's recommended to dry them with a clean cloth after washing to prevent water marks and potential corrosion.
US-BASED CUSTOMER SERVICE LETS YOU BUY WITH CONFIDENCE – OVENTE warranties that the product shall be free from defects in material and workmanship under normal use and conditions, for 1 year from the original purchase date.
